title: Gemini 4 Argon is now available for developers.
gist: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon available to developers via the paid Gemini API tier, AI Studio and Android Studio, with Ultra subscribers getting it in Antigravity. It is positioned for long-horizon work such as code migrations, enterprise knowledge work and cyber defense.

insights.claim: Google positions Gemini 4 Argon as a frontier model for long-horizon workflows needing deep reasoning, such as code migrations and frontier research, targeting software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Google is aiming its top model at high-value, multi-step enterprise and engineering work rather than chat, which is where AI monetization is concentrating.
insights.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is designed for those long-horizon workflows that require deep reasoning and structural precision, including code migrations and frontier research.

insights.claim: Access is tiered: the paid Gemini API tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio is open to developers, while Google AI Ultra subscribers get it in AI Studio and the agent-first platform Google Antigravity.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Gating the frontier model behind paid tiers ties model access to subscription and API revenue.
insights.locator: Start building using the paid tier
